name: Angel Gutierrez
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 8A

items.text: Angel Gutierrez serves on the Chicago Board of Education, having won his seat in 2024. He is deputy director of institutional advancement at Enlace Chicago and previously led fundraising at Chicago Hope Academy and Catholic Charities. During his 2024 campaign, Gutierrez supported expanding school options like selective enrollment, charter, magnet, and trade schools. He wants to improve special education and school bus access. In 2024, he called for a forensic analysis of district expenses to move more money into classrooms. His priorities include reimagining career pathways, addressing $16 billion in deferred maintenance, tackling chronic absenteeism, and managing declining enrollment. He supports Illinois opting into a federal tax-credit scholarship program.
